title: The Golden Compass
author: Philip Pullman
summary: In a world where every person has an animal companion that embodies their soul, a feisty girl sets off for the far north to rescue a friend taken by a mysterious organisation. Along the way she meets armoured bears, witches and aeronauts.
readIf: you want a vivid, fast children's fantasy with big ideas and a very memorable heroine.
skipIf: you want a purely comforting read, as the book includes cruelty to children and questions faith.

pairings.reason: The gentler, older cousin in tone, which many readers treat as the opposite worldview.
Another children's fantasy that gradually grows into something larger and more serious.
The next book in the series, which widens the story to other worlds.
